integration: Branch retrieve_knowledge before Transport, call retrieve using only supported request keys. Local operator CLI only; no job or public tool. Do not call main from transport_cli. No memory-fixed-app changes.
rank_scope: Pure ordering of whole rows only, not filtering, security, obligation selection, validation or budget. build retains scientific allowlist/reread and admits whole blocks only.
catalog_scope: Initial deployment deliberately limited to 3 scientific IDs. Expansion requires explicit review, exact paths/IDs and new embedded catalog pin; request cannot broaden it.
limits: No global errata discovery claimed; protection completeness false, explicit metadata and closure preserved.
Existing graph source/statute is DECLARED, hash confirms bytes only, not proof or truth.
UTF8 accounting covers compact returned JSON; CLI wrapper/provider-specific overhead must use reserved or additional caller budget.
Source hash reads happen only for relevant/mandatory trial groups; some trial groups may be omitted for budget. No source text is emitted.
No opaque source catalog proof; parent/reviewer must validate scope annotations.
